limits: Experimental runner matcher slice; no release, package or performance claim.
Bun inline generation/update policies reject before browser dispatch. Use named file baselines or run the update under Node. Existing inline comparisons remain available.
Public Page/Locator ariaSnapshot methods, automatic failure-context artifacts and out-of-process frames remain separate incomplete capabilities.
Raw browser/runner/resource artifacts are retained privately; this checkpoint preserves their original report hashes and all gate outcomes.
